reviews.title: My first one wasn’t as good as this one. And was more $.
reviews.comment: It’s super, dare I say,…..super duper?! It works as advertised which hardly anything or anyone does anymore. So I’m happy with just that. Go ahead and get you one, and tell them I sent you for a 20 dollar discount. When I mentioned 20 dollar discount just a moment ago, I should tell you that was a joke. It’s only five dollar discount. But seriously though, I am very happy. I had a similar one before with a more aggressive curve, which was really cool, but it was a lot more money. This was the cheapest I could find at this size. I’m not a gamer or know or care about graphics and crap like that, but the picture is great and the extra real estate that comes with an extra wide like this means multi tasking several different windows on the same screen. Increasing productivity. I use it on Fl and it has 5 screens which you can use all at once basically with it. And like I said, it was the cheapest with a fast delivery. So you can’t go wrong. I’ll tell them you’re coming to pick one up so they have one ready for you.
reviews.author: John Sobeski
